metadata.question: Did the smoke plumes originating from fires in Siskiyou County on August 18, 2021, travel northward for at least 20 miles?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need to detect smoke plumes on 2021-08-18 in Siskiyou County, CA. Use MODIS Terra/Aqua combined Level-2 aerosol product (MCDTCLD) or MODIS active-fire plus true-color to visualize plume direction. If not enough pixels, fallback to VIIRS or Sentinel-2 band2/band3 true-color to trace plume. 2. Masking strategy: Smoke shows up as high AOD or bright haze in true-color. If using aerosol band (Optical_Depth_055), no cloud mask needed (question is about smoke). If using true-color, apply a light cloud mask but keep thin smoke. 3. Logic: Define a small polygon at the main fire spot in Siskiyou County, then sample mean AOD (or reflectance) along a 20-mile northward buffer. Compare mean AOD inside the origin fire zone vs. the northern 20-mile zone. If both have valid (non-null) means and the northern zone mean is >0.25× origin mean, consider smoke transported. Validate pixel counts—zero in either zone ⇒ C2; null ⇒ C3; otherwise return A (Yes) or B (No). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time fire = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.4, 41.6]) # approximate center Siskiyou County date = '2021-08-18' start = ee.Date(date) end = start.advance(1, 'day') buf = 5000 # 5 km origin mask zone0 = fire.buffer(buf) # origin zoneN = fire.buffer(buf).transform('EPSG:4326').centroid() \ .buffer(buf).transform('EPSG:4326', 1000) \ .translate(0, 32186) # 20 miles ≈ 32.2 km north # 2. Data Acquisition col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD19A2') \ .filterDate(start, end) \ .select('Optical_Depth_055') if col.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No aerosol images on 2021-08-18.") print("C1") img = col.mean() # composite if >1 granule # 3. Pixel counts c0 = img.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.count(), zone0, 3000, maxPixels=1e9).get('Optical_Depth_055').getInfo() cN = img.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.count(), zoneN, 3000, maxPixels=1e9).get('Optical_Depth_055').getInfo() if c0 == 0 or cN == 0: print("No valid pixels in origin or north zone.") print("C2") # 4. Calculation m0 = img.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.mean(), zone0, 3000, maxPixels=1e9).get('Optical_Depth_055').getInfo() mN = img.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.mean(), zoneN, 3000, maxPixels=1e9).get('Optical_Depth_055').getInfo() print(f"Origin AOD: {m0:.2f}, North20mi AOD: {mN:.2f}, PixelsO:{int(c0)}, PixelsN:{int(cN)}") if m0 is None or mN is None: print("C3") # 5. Decision if mN >= 0.25 * m0 and mN > 0.2: # thresholded smoke signal print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
fire = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.4, 41.6])  # approximate center Siskiyou County
date = '2021-08-18'
start = ee.Date(date)
end = start.advance(1, 'day')
buf = 5000  # 5 km origin mask
zone0 = fire.buffer(buf)  # origin
zoneN = fire.buffer(buf).transform('EPSG:4326').centroid() \
         .buffer(buf).transform('EPSG:4326', 1000) \
         .translate(0, 32186)  # 20 miles ≈ 32.2 km north

# 2. Data Acquisition
col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD19A2') \
        .filterDate(start, end) \
        .select('Optical_Depth_055')
if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No aerosol images on 2021-08-18.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

img = col.mean()  # composite if >1 granule

# 3. Pixel counts
c0 = img.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.count(), zone0, 3000, maxPixels=1e9).get('Optical_Depth_055').getInfo()
cN = img.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.count(), zoneN, 3000, maxPixels=1e9).get('Optical_Depth_055').getInfo()
if c0 == 0 or cN == 0:
    print("No valid pixels in origin or north zone.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")

# 4. Calculation
m0 = img.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.mean(), zone0, 3000, maxPixels=1e9).get('Optical_Depth_055').getInfo()
mN = img.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.mean(), zoneN, 3000, maxPixels=1e9).get('Optical_Depth_055').getInfo()
print(f"Origin AOD: {m0:.2f}, North20mi AOD: {mN:.2f}, PixelsO:{int(c0)}, PixelsN:{int(cN)}")

if m0 is None or mN is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")

# 5. Decision
if mN >= 0.25 * m0 and mN > 0.2:  # thresholded smoke signal
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
